scope: Sources and inherited evidence for the 31 October 2026 aerial-productivity screen. run.py binds the products it reads by schema and hash; the documents here are cited by path. Original datasets and papers are not copied.

local_inputs.use: Carbon allocations per class, geometry, mature replacement, the class mixture, phosphorus stocks and losses before supply: engineered-organism screening scenarios.
The older vertical atmosphere, water-use traits and gas and structure feasibility; coupled traits and wet and dry trajectories are open.
The shared Earth-analogue phosphorus fallout and the optical and physiological precedent; its sources.json holds the original access record.
The surface reference of 18.79 Gt C/year, kept apart from all sky production, and the provisional light sensitivity; biomass_comparison_inputs.json holds the climate references.

The rain channel: the gas-dimming branch A28_gases of the 0.950 design case, 1.694% added dimming, 0.550% of the land's rain per per cent of dimming, and rain-fed growth changes of -0.118 to -0.122 Gt C/year at the light-limitation study's ends.
Reef passes per sky town a day at 1% cover, with reefs half the cover, for the shared-sky scaling.
Beam switches per receiver a day at 1% cover for sky towns and ground receivers in operation, for the shared-sky scaling.

published_sources.citation: Dillon KP et al. (2020), Cyanobacteria and Algae in Clouds and Rain in the Area of puy de Dome, Central France
published_sources.use: Viable oxygenic phototrophs occur in cloud and rain samples: biological precedent for aerial phototrophs, with their production rates and any lunar carrying capacity still to be measured.

published_sources.citation: Peguilhan R et al. (2025), Clouds influence the functioning of airborne microorganisms
published_sources.access: Publisher abstract and indexed results and discussion excerpts read 2026-10-31
published_sources.use: Metabolic activity depends on cloud-water conditions; a complete productive aerial life cycle needs more than atmospheric depth or cloud presence.

published_sources.citation: Mercado LM et al. (2009), Impact of changes in diffuse radiation on the global land carbon sink
published_sources.access: Publisher and repository index records inspected; the publisher page could not be opened. No numerical input is taken from this paper.
published_sources.use: Context for the distinction between diffuse redistribution and extra photons; the local canopy products supply the numerical responses.

new_scenario_choices: Summed projected area at 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50 and 100% of the Moon's area, each a prescribed scenario.
A vertical-beam Poisson column with mixed or class-stratified positions; angular and cloud radiative transfer are open.
Mature adult hazard 0.003 a year, low-maintenance photolytic reference bodies and the existing 50/30/20 class mix.
Surface elasticities of 0.65 for wet margins, 0.6 for productive coasts, 0.1 for oligotrophic waters and 0.8 for the rain-fed light potential, approximating the inherited model responses.
The rain channel: rain-fed growth falls by 0.496 of the intercepted share of sunlight, the gas-dimming branch's loss over the mean rain-fed growth of 14.3 Gt C/year, as a first-order estimate.
Shared-sky rates scaled linearly in cover from their products' 1% basis.
Half of unallocated assimilate converted to tissue is a potential allocation with its nutrients and the destination of its mass still to be found, and stays out of the headline increment.
Microbial columns with a prescribed 0.2 favourable duty and 3.6-day doubling; an optimistic engineered case with 0.5 duty and 1-day doubling.

scattering_context.use: Existing diffuse and underside light evidence, used to interpret the whole-sky angular transport still to be computed; no production multiplier is added.
scattering_context.claims: On the older clear-sky columns diffuse PAR is 37, 56 and 80% at solar elevations of 90, 30 and 10 degrees; the canopy baseline includes diffuse illumination; at 10 km a lone body's underside receives 19-30% and a reef's underside 11-22% of the light on a horizontal top surface over ground albedos of 0.05-0.2. Attenuation and production in a crowded aerial community are still to be computed.
